text: Decided on 9/10/01 to cancel my reservation at the hotel across from the Twin Towers in NY because I was too tired to drive.
Realized I forgot my quarters for doing laundry when I was in college. Almost turned around to go back to my dorm. Saw a cute boy and he let me borrow some. We're now married with 2 kids ✨💜
Quit my job as pshyc nurse to work any easy job at a hotel, ended up becoming the owner
Went on the date my mom convinced me to go on because “it’s free sushi, not like you’re going to marry the guy” I did in fact marry him
Made up a phone number & texted it. Ended up marrying that man & having 3 beautiful kiddos together. (He died in 2019 but is still so loved) 🖤
Left my ex, dated a non English speaking Mexican, moved to Mexico and Colombia. I am now the onsite bilingual safety manager pulling 6 figures.
Opend up my husbands ipad where all his messages were synced
Stayed friends with an ex after he put me out his house. He died and left me everything he had stocks 401 k everything!! All my friends said stop being his friend
I missed the turn on Aug 9, 2019 at the El Paso Walmart, where the mass shooting happened. When I turned back it was full of cops , helicopters.
Got a mammogram. Diagnosed with NON hodkins lymphoma. Just finished chemo for the 2nd time.
Got so bored one day during the lockdowns that I filled out a grad school application. Now I’m a therapist 🤷‍♀
Said no to a blind date may of 2021. In April 2022 I met a guy at a bar who asked me to dance. After conversation we figured out I was the girl who said no. We’ve been together since Feb 2023
Stopped eating sweets for a day. Then another day, then a week, then a month. Lost 50lbs from breaking my sweet addiction
Accidentally messaged this guy on fb when I meant to message another guy I was crushing on. The guy I accidentally messaged is now my husband and today is our 14th anniversary.
Googled summer internships my 2nd year of pharmacy school, found one at Johns Hopkins, applied as a joke and got in. Changed my whole career trajectory!
got ask to run for local judge seat, decided to go for it. Won the election, and have the distinct honor of being the first and only female hispanic JP in our county.
Asked the random boy sitting next to me if I could join his group project in college. We’ve been together for 13 years with 3 kids. If I had picked a different seat that day we would have never met
I participated as an “attorney” in a mock trial in 6th grade. now I’m a trial attorney
I started walking one day. Realized I enjoyed it. Kept walking several times a week. The started an exercise program and cleaned up my diet. Lost 60 pounds
I was speeding to my job because I was late. Got pulled over and found out the cop was from a small town one town over from my small town. 800 miles away. Been married 43 years and have 2 kids.
Chose free pizza over buying a salad at work before my shift. Met my husband over pizza ❤
Came here to say making my bed in the morning makes me have less anxiety but that is not the energy here HAHAHA yall are crushing life
Joined AOL in 1998. Randomly went to a chat room. Started chatting with this guy 3500 miles away. 27 yrs later, we just celebrated our 25 wedding anniversary.

Applied for a full ride - required an essay . Submitted it after my counselor convinced me. Made the deadline with 30 minutes to spare. Won a full ride , books, uniform , and all. A decade later still in the same field that was supposed to just be temporary
I’m the biggest homebody on the planet but my coworker insisted I come with her to a holiday party. I met my husband that night. Just celebrated 21 very happy yrs of marriage 🥰

My dad and I were at a concert and I left early because something just told me to go check on my sister. Drove to her house, saw no car, used my key to get in anyways to look around and found her overdosed in her room. Saved her life because I left! Also have a similar story of leaving work early (which is extremely out of character for me at the time) to get home about 15 minutes before my mom had a heart attack. Needless to say, when I feel like I need to leave, I leave 🤷‍♀

Was the 1st car at a stoplight while eight months pregnant, my two-year-old was in the backseat, the light turned green and as I was about to go my two-year-old said “mommy” really loud but didn’t want anything, as I was turning back around a semi plowed through the intersection when their light was red and would’ve T boned us if I went when it was my turn. It still gives me chills.
This is the best comment section I think ive ever read!!
I was able to make it through yesterday. I made it through today, and have a little more hope for tomorrow despite how severe this PPD is and being completely alone.
I took a job as a janitor at a very prestigious college. I noticed these math problems written on chalk in the hallway and started solving them (EZ). Anyways, my best friend is Ben Affleck

I opened TT up and came across this post. I was expecting negative experiences, but was pleasantly surprised to see positive responses. Changed my whole outlook on life, humanity and hope for the future. 🥰

On the late night of April 1, 2022, I decided to take a detour from my job while on my way home from work. I stopped at an H-E-B grocery store and died on the floor of aneurysm. I was only saved because people of the public intervened and I was rushed to the hospital. If I had not stopped at that grocery store, I would have gone home and died in my sleep.
Decided like 6 days before prom to go with a guy as friends. We have now been married for 4 years ❤
Started painting and selling them a month ago and have now made over $1000 😭

I decided to sort laundry. Went into my bedroom & all my pets followed me. About 90 seconds later, a car came flying through my entire home. My home collapsed & immediately caught fire. My bedroom was literally the only non-fatal space in my entire home. We were all in the living room less than 2 minutes before. We would've all been killed instantly if I didn't decide to sort laundry
I cut everyone off and moved far away and started over. Met my husband got married and had a baby and my parents/siblings have no clue where I am. They were horrible people. I’ve never been happier
I was between jobs so I got a part time serving job. It’s turns out I hate accounting and love hospitality and now I’m a sommelier.
Decided to try dry January, been sober 2 years now 😁
So apply for a job on a whim, tinder…? Bar…?? Gym?? Make my bed.. what else?? I love this for the collective!

My friend was coming over to visit me with her boyfriend I never met. She called me back a few mins later and asked if her bf could bring his friend. I heard her eye roll through the phone. I said that was fine. Married for 17 years this Saturday.
Quit a job I hated, went to work at another corporation. Met my husband there, he was my boss. 😳 We’ve been together 17 years. Now I’m the boss! lol
Checked my (ex) husband's locations to see if he was on the way home with the groceries for dinner and he was cheating on me 🥰

Messed w a DJs turntables jokingly once at a rooftop party when he walked away. Instead of being upset he taught me things, gifted me gear and I’m 15yrs in as a wedding DJ n I get to DJ for celebs regularly. I was the DJ fr the Whim Whammie vid

I decided to pull my window down and talk to the guy on the motorcycle, he had his helmet on and I didn’t even see his face. Got his number and 3 years later we are married with a beautiful 8 month old.
I swiped right on some guy I thought was cute on Tinder, ten years later we share a last name, three kids, two dogs and a mortgage 🤣
Husband (at the time) said he wouldn’t get a job so I should find a 2nd. So I did and then became besties with my boss at that job 🫣 so when hubby and I split, guess who was first in line for me?
Jokingly applied for a job I didn’t think I was qualified for. Now 2 years into my career & making more $ than ppl twice my age, life only keeps getting better. All because I took a chance on myself
Joined a yoga studio just to “try it”….I’ve never been consistent with any type of exercise ever. In 7 months I completed 100 classes.
Saving 30 of my checks 💵 used to spend everything I made but on year I challenged my to save 10k for the year…that yr I somehow saved 60k & haven’t turned back since👌✨
Swiped right on a guy and said “eh, he’ll probably break my heart but at least he’s hot asf.” Ended up being the love of my life right there
Applying at a temp agency. Turned into an entirely different career where I’m making $650k a year.
Start taking care of my health. Lost 200lbs and running 5k’s. Life has been amazing❤

Thank y’all for giving me hope that something great is going to happen in my life one day. I really needed this after telling a boy I loved him and getting the ultimate F you. Thank you all so much ❤️❤️❤
i decided that everytime i got sad about a break up i would apply for internships and summer jobs and my life completely changed
Stopping my negative thoughts. I now say “thank you for trying to protect me but that’s just not true”
Making a body butter to help my sone with itchy skin but it actually cleared his eczema! I turned it into a business. 🤎🤎🤎
I stopped doing everyone’s laundry 4 months ago. Life changing!
Started eating healthy. Do Pilates and changed my whole lifestyle. Lost over 70 pounds. I was a recluse before this just wasting my 20s away til I said no more.

Couldn’t find a job out of college. Became a bank teller out of desperation ,and then got transferred into the mortgage department. That job brought me to my career in investment banking and working on Wall Street for 20 years. Never a choice, just a coincidence
i abruptly quit my job as a dominos manager and it led me to getting an entry IT job that led me to making alot more money than i ever wouldve at dominos
Wanted to move closer to my job. Was looking for an apartment, but decided to apply for a home loan. I’ve been in my house for 4yrs

I didn’t get the Photography class I wanted in high school. They scheduled me in computer drafting instead because it was the same teacher. Loved it so much I got a college degree in Architecture. Still love my career 20 years later.
Got a dog..she has become my best friend..and I believe she has cured my depression! She is such a sweet baby...she loves me unconditionally!!
Got tired of the groomer hacking my dog when they groomed him. inquired about grooming school, messed around and enrolled...8 years strong!💪🏾🐶

I was in college and lonely so I decided to get a dog. Found a cute little guy at a shelter 2 hrs away and drove to pick him up that day. When saying our goodbyes, I found out he would have been euthanized the next day had I not adopted him. We’ve been together for 14 years now ❤

Said f it and signed up for community college a week before registration closed. Now i graduated with a degree in construction management and on track to make 115k as a first year. Finally able to help my dad like i always dreamed of and give him a better life.
Passed up for leadership at my old job, I got upset and applied to a new job that I got hired for and doubled my salary

Got tired of being depressed and self destructive all the time. Made an appointment with a psychiatrist and it changed my whole life. Lost weight, got ahold of my mental health and live a much more peaceful life 🙌🏻
Became educated and left the family who abused me

After I graduated college, I decided to apply for 100 positions one weekend because I hated my job. I ended up being selected at a job and ended up making twice as much as I made. They also paid ALL of my student loan debt AND paid for my masters😮‍💨! I also bring in well over 6 figures for years now. To God be the glory!
Didn’t buy last minute tickets to Taylor Swift’s reputation tour even though I really wanted to go. Met my husband that night at a bar instead.
I was bs’ing at work reading celeb gossip 7 years ago and read an article about Teyana Taylor’s pregnancy and discovered doulas. I’m now a Doula and learning how to be a Lactation counselor.

Went thru a bad divorce. Decided to move back to my hometown but didn’t want to. Last minute decided to stay in the town I was living in with my bff. 6 months later, my bff asks me to marry him, we’ve been happily married for 30yrs, 2 grown boys and a 14 yr old Grandson. Best decision of my life. ❤️❤

College instead of the military. I’m underprivileged & was labeled independent. Graduated while homeless in high school. I am in week 4 of their 1 year nursing program (: 48 more weeks and I’ll be a nurse!!
Went to delete my OkCupid account. There was a new message and I decided to respond. We’ve been married 12 years 😝

“I wonder what all the hype is about K-Pop?” Fell down a rabbit hole. Became a fan. Went to a DPR Ian concert on my own in Chicago last year. Met a Korean man. We’ll be married next year and am moving to Seoul.

Applied for food stamps went to school they said because I have food stamps my nursing degree is free. I graduate in May with my RN y’all 💞. If you get stamps or any assistance even unemployment look into “Workforce (School) or Worksource (Career) it saved my life 🥰)
Said I wanted to travel more and deserved a higher paying job. That week I got a callback offer and got hired with a desk job at an airline with full flight benefits. ✨
understood that "no" is a complete sentence.
Took a welding class at community college as a cna… now a journeyman mechanic
Became self centered instead of male centered and dropped all my friends that were male centered as well 😇
Asking chat gpt to find me jobs had it write my resume and poly for me. Tripled my salary and do way less than I used to

At 27yo, after several awful Tinder dates, I got on my app to delete it. The first thing I saw was my 5th grade crush’s profile. He had already swiped on me. Sent a quick “hi, haven’t seen you in years!” and now we’ve together 6.5 years (married 4). 🫶🏻
Somebody like this so I can come back to read all of them! 🥰

I didn’t attend the midnight showing of “The Dark Night Rises” at the movie theater in aurora, CO. I was there on business and my coworker wouldn’t go with me, even though I was pleading with him. So he basically saved my life.

My New Year’s resolution was to do the opposite of everything I did that year so my best friend told me the first thing I should do is call the guy that’s been asking me out that I’ve turned down. Yesterday was our 12th wedding anniversary.

realized that walking away felt like it might kill me, but staying definitely would. took the gamble on myself, so i changed my name, moved to a new state, started a business, and lost 60lbs. 4.5 years later and im about to be engaged to the lead guitarist of one of my fav bands
taking calculus 2 as a freshman in college, which made me realize just how much i like math (im graduating in the spring with a BS in math 😊)
Not my story but my aunts, they were friend with the neighbor. The neighbor even watched the kids grow up. When he passed away he had left the house under one of the kid’s name.
I went to the humane association to adopt a cat. Came out with a 12 week German shepherd puppy. She turns 5 next month & is one of the reasons I’m still here today.
Do dishes before bed no matter what. Pray about everything

2 weeks before I turned 40, I missed my turn off after work at my corporate job, stopped at a place to sit and eat some food where I met the 80yr old guy who’d eventually ask me to be his dominatrix 💀
Auditioned for the Morgan State University Choir! Changed my whole life for GOOD!
Passively replied back to a recruiter’s email. Mail ended up landing a job over 100 K and got to move to Florida.

Skipped class in college for the first time ever because my BFF didn’t want to go to her class. Met my now husband while sitting in the student center just chatting with students. That was almost 40 years ago. 😜

Went with my high school boyfriend to his appointment with an Air Force recruiter. I knew nothing about the military but We both ended up signing up to enlist… but at the last minute he chickened out and didn’t join. I joined, broke up with him and just retired after 22 years (with full retirement benefits for the rest of my life)

My mom’s bf made me tour a university that half of my family attended, when I wanted to go to the one my other half of the family went to bc my mom went to that one .. well I loved it, was 20 min late to my first class ever freshman year.. sat next to the sweetest and weirdest guy bc that was the only seat left.. 6 years later and we are engaged!! He proposed last month

Decided to go to the gym the morning after getting fired from my job in hopes of trying to have a good day. Right before leaving for the gym I had a really bad fall (fell face first on the concrete) that led me to urgent care. Urgent care led me to getting a CT scan to check for facial fractures. CT scan just so happened to catch a golf ball sized tumor. Eventually got diagnosed with thyroid cancer. I hadn’t worked out for a year before that day.

I got a puppy after my husband died. The puppy chewed up my carpet so I got new flooring. In order to lay the flooring, I had to clear out my house. Since my house was cleared out, I decided to paint all the walls. Since I cleared the walls to paint, I bought new wall hangings. My puppy demanded a lot of my time, so I bought a puppy for my puppy. now I have two puppies and a completely remodeled house! 😅

Decided to wash dishes before heading downstairs to catch the super bowl. Our house was on fire. Had i not done the dishes i wouldn’t have seen the flames outside the kitchen window. Luckily the damage was not much and we were all safe 🙏

I called the community college, told them Id like to go to college but didn't know what to do. I was 30, didn't think college was for people like me from a blue collar family, or that I was even smart enough. I didn't really think anything would come out of that phone call, but the lady told me to come see her. I ended up with a Masters degree.
Had a coworker ask randomly if I was pregnant, got paranoid and took a test. I was, it was ectopic. Ruptured 3 days later.
I gave up drinking and smoking. All things that had control over me

Sent a hunger games meme to a complete stranger on twitter back in 2011(neither of us even remember how we started following each other) Now we’ve been married for almost 7 years and our first baby is on her way ❤
Put an add on Craigslist looking for a roommate. Someone wrote back and I moved in. Met my husband at the apartment complex
Quit my job with no back up, landed my dream job a month later!!
I’m so proud of you guys and grateful that yall are still here 💜🥹
Ozempic Jan 1. Down over 120lbs and never felt better. Dang pregnancy weight was literally ruining my will to live. I feel alive again

Studied abroad in London… met my besties there. Moved to Hawaii together. Met my husband in Hawaii… moved back to PA together, landed my “dream job” and have 2 kids…. All bc I decided to study abroad in London in 2005.
Left a toxic marriage and God gave me soooo many blessings: new car, bought a home, 2 raises, and even with no child support we are living great. Bless God 🙌🏾
left a job that was paying well and I was advancing in to move with my parents to Wisconsin and ended up getting a better paying job and meeting my wife here.
Called in too much at work and got fired and got a better job and stopped alcohol.👍😁👍

Found out my bf at the time was talking to woman online. Gave myself a 3 day pas to prove a point to him it’s hurtful. On day 2, I found a man that treats me better than any man ever has. We moved in together, about to celebrate our 1 year and plan on getting married 🥰🙌
Decided to go to college at 44 and study Nursing which was something I always dreamed to do! It’s crazy how much my life has changed since that moment. Never looked back.
I like to do volunteer work, went to a volunteer event and ended up with a job in corporate leadership.
Showed up to vball open gym for a friend and 4 years later had a full ride to a D1 school, 3 NCAA appearances, 2 ACC championships. God bless my high school coach!
I was desperate for a job so I went to the Air Force recruiting office. The recruiter was at lunch and I never went back. I wonder how my life would be different if I had joined the military

Went out with my landlord for her brothers birthday. Never met her brother and REALLLLYYYYY didn’t want to go. 15 years later her brother and I have 3 kids, own a very successful business, have the house of our dreams. Weird how one action can change the entire trajectory of our lives. I always think about how trippy of a concept it is.

worked a retail job to have flex hours while I went to college. finished 2 degrees. got fired, moved to the opposite end of the country, got a job that has nothing to do with my degrees and now make 6 figures without leaving home. yay for being fired
Moved to New York with $400 and no job
Met a guy on a last minute “girls trip” who lived 7.5 hours away. We’re now married with kids…18 years later.
My abusive dad sent me a pic of him and his mistress on vacation and I told my mom. She found out he was cheating. They’ve since divorced and he’s completely out of my life thank God

Got out of the car to scare my wife. Accidentally discovered her affair. Been divorced for a couple of years and, honestly, it’s the best thing that could have happened to me. I’m in much better shape, closer to God, and earning more than I ever did when I was with her. All I can say is God is good!

It didn’t change my life but- I stopped at Dairy Queen on a Saturday on the way home from work but when I got in the parking lot I just got an uneasy feeling. I decided to just go home and didn’t get ice cream. I ended up being the only car waiting at an intersection red light where a serious car accident happened. Driver flew head first into the passenger side dash and was bleeding profusely from a head wound and choking simultaneously (eating a hamburger). I just so happen to be an RN so I was able to stop the choking and the bleeding. I was the only person on scene that knew what to do (not bragging, it’s just an unfortunate fact) until the ambulance arrived 10 minutes later. He would’ve been gone by then 😭. They life-flighted him and he was released from ICU 2 days later!! So many things lined up perfectly for me to be there at that time. I don’t normally work on Saturdays, I stopped for groceries even though I was exchausted, decided to leave DQ, etc. Gives me chills every time I think about it 🩵
Messaged a guy on fb to say hi 2 months after I cancelled our first date 😬 - We’re about to celebrate our 12th wedding anniversary in Madeira🥰

Never trust your thoughts after 9pm. For me how that resulted is whenever I start the rabbit hole of rumination and thinking I’m not good enough, not smart, not witty, not as rich or great as my friends or random people on insta —- I just pause — is it past 9pm? Have I drank water ? Have I went outside and frolicked in the grass? Have I talked to my family and bestfriends? Have I prayed or listened to a sermon? And I promise you the devil can’t get past all of those things!😁
I’m at work on a 12-hr shift. . I’ve been in these comments reading them between patients. I started reading at 9am .. it’s now 1:55 pm😂😂

Married a thinker. I had a very bad headache. Doctor sent me home with painkillers and said you’ll be fine in a couple days. Wifey didn’t buy it. She called her nurse friend who is married to a UCLA doctor. Wifey told him my symptoms and he said “take him to emergency right now!” Turns out I had meningitis and brain swelling that would have been fatal without treatment. ER Dr put me on IV, hospitalized for 5 days. Cognition didn’t fully recover for 5 years. All good now. Second opinions matter.
Decided to get a personal trainer. He’s now my husband and we have 3 kids
Accidentally applied to LPN school and now I’m going back for a masters 😅

Went back to school at 45, became an NP, had a spiritual awakening, changed jobs, let go of toxic friends and forgave those whom I was carrying in my heart. Now I am more at peace than I ever have been in my whole life. Gods plan is a real thing yall

Just had gotten out of a relationship. I’m a guy that never deleted any emails, I had about 75,000 sitting in my inbox. I’m searching for 1 important email for work and come across this email saying someone had messaged me from a dating app I’ve had deleted for months. I decided to open it and redownload the app just to see what it was all about, I’m a guy that never had women messaging me might I add. Well now we’re married with a house, dog and the most amazing 2 year old son

I took a job that paid well but had zero work life balance. I was watching a Canadian hospital soap and was like, I bet there's hospital jobs I can do. Went administrative and went, I bet I could be a nurse. I'm currently on my way to becoming an NP all because of a TV show😂

A friend asked me to make shirts for their club so I figured out that. Then someone asked for flags so I figured out that. Then pins, challenge coins, hats, koozies, cups… a few years later and I’ve never even advertised.
Decided to befriend my sworn enemy in 8th grade after she ended up in all of my classes. 39 years later, and we still talk every day. 😍😍😍

Downloaded Tiktok and learned I'm not just a gifted and talented kid, now burned out with late diagnosed adhd and Tism and it's pretty much 180° my life and career. Also it educated/healed my relationship wounds. Much better off

Went to get a chicken fried dteak for dinner (alone). My husband was the mgr on duty at the restaurant. We chatted. We went out. We married 3 months later. Happily ever after for 25 years and counting
Was a burnt out elementary teacher who decided to go back to school for an engineering degree. Best decision of my life.
I wrote a self motivational quote in my bathroom…. Got “ kicked out” the abusive house 😗😌I’m 5 years free from the cult
Stopped eating frozen and fried foods
Quitting my job, trusting my husband and moving across the country (while pregnant) to become a stay at mom. It was literally the greatest thing we did for our family.
i was checking in for a flight and decided to switch to an earlier time. at the last minute i changed my mind and switched back to my original flight. i met my now husband on the flight
Was exhausted one night but my friend convinced me to go out. Saw a guy that I casually met 6 months prior and we talked. We have been married 22 years and have 3 daughters. 😁

Took a leap of faith & accepted a job in TX. Flew in to town from PA to meet with a local realtor to find a home. Found a home & moved my 2 daughters to TX to start my new job. Met my husband 6 months later and married 6 months after that. Happily married 10 yrs now & that local realtor is our friend & has now helped us with 2 homes.

Was going for one of my daily walks. Had my headphones on, jamming and was strutting like I was the main character in life. Something told me to turn my music down and walk a little slowly. A few moments later, a car drove into the house I JUST about to walk next to. Had I not slowed down, I would have been jammed into a house. No one but God 🥹🤲🏾
Went to a friend’s bonfire after a HORRIBLE Bumble date and then ran into a guy I hadn’t seen in years and reconnected. We will celebrate being married 3 years this coming Thursday.💗
Decided to volunteer in my kid’s school. Now I’m a teacher 🤷‍♀

I am the eldest of the family and my mom was very controlling of my life. I couldn’t date alot or go out. I was 23 when I met my now husband and she never liked him. She knew I would never leave her she always made me feel guilty for wanting to have my own life. One day I sneaked out my house and she found out and told me to come home but my husband & I knew she was going to hit me. So he told me “Run away with me, I think its time” he had asked before but I always said “I cant leave my siblings behind” until that day. I told him “Ok lets go” well ever since then, I found happiness. a loving man who takes care of me and gave me 2 beautiful children and encouraged me to go back to school. ❤️❤️We are turning 10 years this year!
Random google search for graduate schools and discovered a degree I didn't know existed. Moved to California for it, met my partner, and am now working a job that uses my degrees 🎓
Scrolling on TikTok and signing up to volunteer with a local outreach organization— through this group I was introduced to my now husband by the founders

Threw my keys in the safe and walked off my retail managment job at 23y. Called the local community college and asked how to enroll. HS didn't care to advise this teen mom. Started the upcoming semester and by next one I was accepted into the top nursing program in my area This was 17 years ago! 💅🏼💃🏻
Read a fanfiction called Manacled on AO3, loved it so much I decided to make my own copy, now I bind books and notebooks for fun :)
I moved to ATL in a whim in 01/2021 and completely rebranded myself and my life. I’ve grown so much.
I made a comment on a TikTok post one time. Now, I’ve been with the same woman for almost 5 years and we have a 2 year old son.
decided on a whim to get my first tattoo. while waiting for my appointment I walked into a sporting goods store. my future husband was the manger of that store. we met that day!

At 18, I called out to my summer job at a grocery store. The manager was new and just fired all the teenagers for small infractions. My fellow fired coworker got us jobs at his grandmother's nursing home, and I am still in healthcare administration 30 years later.
Ghosted a weird guy my mom was pressuring me to date & went out to the bar with a friend. Met my husband &father to my youngest son that night 🥰 now a SAHM & living my dreams

Randomly taught myself to make French macarons when snowed-in during a storm because I had nothing to do and it eventually “snowballed” into a 9 year long business. My business got featured in a Netflix show, did my biggest collab for some NBA playoff games and so many other incredible things. Only ended recently because my family and I moved to start our lives! 🥲

I checked my hidden Facebook messages on a work lunch break and found messages from my biological sister and family who had spent 19 years trying to find me. A week later I met them and now it's been almost 10 years and we are closer than ever! We even got to be pregnant at the same time and our kids are 2 months apart. my life got brighter that day ☺
Booked a tandem skydive. Now I own the skydiving business, I’m a skydiving instructor and have been with my tandem instructor for 4 and a half years. 🤷‍♀
Adjusting my expectations of people to prevent disappointment.

We overslept and decided to eat breakfast with my husbands parents before leaving for a work trip. If we had kept our itinerary then we could have possibly been on the Webbers falls bridge when it collapsed

Not really changed my life but my daughters. I signed her up for dance when she was 4 years old just to give her something to do and see if she would like it . She fell in love with it . Now she’s 13 and has been dancing for 9 years. I’m not trying to fear monger, but being a bedside nurse is deeply traumatizing. Hospitals operate on profit, not patient care, and it shows. On top of making life or death decisions every shift, we’re constantly penalized for minor, non-clinical tasks like forgetting to update a whiteboard in a patient’s room. Patients, who are understandably frustrated, often don’t realize the impossible position we’re in. You can be running a code trying to save someone’s life while another patient is upset because their call light to use the bathroom wasn’t answered right away. Staffing is chronically unsafe, with burnout and call-outs leaving fewer hands to manage overwhelming patient loads. Many shifts don’t allow for a proper meal or even a bathroom break. It’s 12 straight hours of stress, anxiety, and emotional weight. Nurses are also expected to take on non nursing roles like housekeeping tasks or passing food trays, simply because there’s no support staff. And while those jobs are important, they should not fall to the same person who is simultaneously titrating life-sustaining medications like levophed for critically ill patients. In my trauma ICU, and honestly across every specialty, I don’t know a single nurse who has been in the field for more than five years who still likes their job. That says everything about how broken this system is. At the bedside, the demands are endless, the pressure is crushing, and the support is almost nonexistent. At this point I disassociate because it is a paycheck which I am grateful to have but the entire day before your shift you dread and then the day after a shift it’s almost like you are hungover or beat up because of the emotional toll it takes. I actually started applying to work from home jobs that are literally half of what I make because my quality of life as a bedside nurse ☹
